cases.input: 我这阶段优先自由职业接单，实习稍后再看。只记方向，不安排任务。
cases.expected: Stated direction/priority is an active goal not an experience; no task plan.

cases.input: 我这次接单的社团海报做完交给客户了，他说已经用了，但还没有付款。
cases.expected: Actual task, reported adoption, unpaid distinct exact facts; effectiveness and future fit unknown, no beginner tutorial.

cases.input: 我不再把自由职业作为主线，之后优先找实习。之前海报交付的记录请保留。
cases.expected: Old direction/goal and starmap pursuit paused, actual experience preserved; direction change not new experience.

cases.input: 创业这边我问了两位同学，他们觉得听起来有意思，但谁也还没用。我想把访谈问题改成“你最近一次遇到这件事，最后怎么处理的？”
cases.expected: Interest and actual no-use separate; asked is own action, no-use not attempted or failed demand; only proposed step edit, effect unknown.

cases.input: 刚才那次访谈我暂时不继续，也不要给我别的方法。愿意聊不代表他们会用。
cases.expected: No repeated tutorial; actual interest/no-use retained, no completed revised interview or fabricated effect, respect pause/refusal.

cases.input: 我这周只剩一个半小时，课程和备考怎么取舍？先别都铺开。
cases.expected: Current remaining 90 minutes, one missing actual requirement, no universal grades/career effect, no invented budget split.

cases.input: 这周后面都排满了，能用的时间是零。下周大概有四小时，先不排具体任务。
cases.expected: This-week zero supersedes current 90-minute budget; future 240 remains distinct future active; no stale label or old plan use.

cases.input: 还有另一件事，我请教导师的邮件已经发出去了，对方看过但没有回应。我现在只想聊聊感受，别建议我催。
cases.expected: Separate contact event, read/no reply known, adoption/payment/effect unknown; listen only, no wrong freelance/startup facts.
